item.name: G-Warstaff
item.cardSummary: Cosmetic cursed tool: the G-Warstaff's white trail slowly reddens as the Awakening bar fills.

item.name: Clairvoyance
item.cardSummary: Marks an opponent's torso with a glowing manga panel for 25 seconds at up to 35 studs, letting the Mangaka read their future and stack disadvantages on them.

item.name: Despair
item.cardSummary: Rapid spear thrusts into an unblockable finishing slash that launches the enemy. Slows down when it misses or hits an unmarked block.

item.name: Shut Up!
item.cardSummary: A reverse spear stab that punishes anyone standing behind you, with i-frames during the stare-down before the target is spun to the front and kicked away.

item.name: Eye Catching
item.cardSummary: A brief block stance counter: any melee or bullet that connects gets dodged with a spin and the attacker knocked down.

item.name: Sacrilege
item.cardSummary: A twirl into a 20-stud spear dash. Connecting triggers an angry text-box scolding along with the damage.

item.name: Foresight
item.cardSummary: A vertical spear guard that blocks a melee hit and smacks the attacker up and away.

item.name: Despair
item.cardSummary: Awakened Despair: repeated spear thrusts ending in a ground slam.

item.name: Foresight
item.cardSummary: Foresight's execution: against attackers at 40 HP or less the cutscene triggers even without a Clairvoyance mark, ending them outright.

item.name: Demon of the Modern Era
item.cardSummary: The cockroach curse's form itself: towering height, face antennas, an extra pair of arms, and the Festering Life Sword.

item.name: Festering Life Sword
item.damage: 3 per injury (1.5/s, 1/s if stalled), 14 for hatch
item.cardSummary: Injury system: afflicted players carry an injury meter, and each expended stack ticks 3 damage over time.

item.name: Earthen Insect Trance
item.cooldown: 15s, starts once Earthen Insects are gone
item.cardSummary: Summons two earthen insects carrying blinding sacs that trail the user for 15 seconds before they can be sent at enemies.

item.name: Festering Strikes
item.cardSummary: Three tactical blade swings that apply injury through block and cancel ragdoll, with the final hit damaging through block.

item.name: Detach
item.cardSummary: Launches the sword-holding arm forward on a bridge of cockroaches; used airborne, it pulls the user along.

item.name: Chokehold
item.cardSummary: The spare arms lunge for a neck grab that stalls the target's injury drain while a Festering slash winds up.

item.name: Roach Swarm
item.cardSummary: Commands a roach horde to shred everything 35 studs ahead, ragdolling targets away.

item.name: Parthenogenesis
item.cardSummary: Spends all cursed energy to split in two, with full i-frames once the white highlight appears.

item.name: Invasion
item.cardSummary: Parthenogenesis at a domain border instead sends the roach swarm to chew an entry hole through the dome.

item.name: Chokehold
item.cardSummary: Finisher: one clean Festering slash removes the target's legs.

item.name: Roach Swarm
item.cardSummary: Finisher: roaches strip the target to a skeleton.

item.name: Convergence
item.cardSummary: The special conjures four condensed blood orbs that empower other attacks and change how Supernova behaves.

item.name: Piercing Blood
item.cardSummary: A hand clap that fires trapped blood as an uncounterable 30-stud beam.

item.name: Flowing Red Scale
item.damage: 13, 3 for rush and per kick, 4 for last hit
item.cardSummary: A technique-boosted short dash that opens a three-hit combo on contact.

item.name: Supernova
item.cardSummary: Without orbs, a brief cross-armed guard that hardens the impact point against melee hits and counters.

item.name: Blood Edge
item.cardSummary: Twin blood daggers: a left-hand jab into a front-flip right-hand floor slam that launches the target.

item.name: Duty as a Brother
item.cardSummary: The Awakening call: blood bursts outward as three faint figures answer, opening the awakened kit.

item.name: Convergence
item.cardSummary: The awakened special works like base Convergence, but all orbs vanish when the Awakening ends.

item.name: Slicing Exorcism
item.damage: 3 per tick, +12 for every orb, up to 39
item.cardSummary: Streams available orbs into a pressurized cutting jet that ragdolls anyone caught to the floor.

item.name: Wing King
item.damage: 43.75, 28.75 for flurry, 15 for pull and slam
item.cardSummary: A lunging flurry of kicks and punches with melee and bullet i-frames, capped by a long-range arm extension.

item.name: Blood Rain
item.cardSummary: A giant blood sphere erupts upward and rains pellets over 35 studs while the user acts freely after the windup.

item.name: Plasma Wave
item.cardSummary: The maximum technique: fourteen orbs spin up a 120-stud cone of blood with scaling damage.

item.name: Supernova
item.cardSummary: Finisher at 7 HP or less: a punch so hard the user's own arm severs on release.

item.name: Blood Edge
item.cardSummary: Extended Blood Edge finisher: twelve slashes and stabs before the target is kicked away.

item.name: Fly High
item.cardSummary: Passive: axe uppercuts launch nearly twice as high, at the cost of M1s never hitting airborne ragdolled enemies.

item.name: Flock
item.cardSummary: Airborne front dashes hop straight forward into a kick that pops the enemy up, then a 10-stud jump to meet them.

item.name: Bounding
item.cardSummary: Front dashing over a ragdolled airborne target springboards off them for about 5 extra studs of height.

item.name: Spatial Transference
item.cardSummary: The user's sibling appears with a white sheet and teleports them 20 studs along their walking direction.

item.name: Impetus Updraft
item.cardSummary: A vertical axe swing that launches on hit and leaves heavy endlag on a miss.

item.name: Circling
item.cardSummary: Two long spinning axe swings, the second launching targets far; a blocked swing staggers the user.

item.name: Murmurate
item.damage: 14, 9 on first hit, 5 if hit again
item.cardSummary: Throws the axe to orbit like a disk while the user steers its path by moving.

item.name: Bird Control
item.cardSummary: Calls a crow mount: stand still (or strafe) during the cast and the bird carries the user.

item.name: Bird Strike
item.cardSummary: Commands a crow seen through its own eyes, then takes full control of its flight path.

item.name: Bird Strike
item.cardSummary: Bird Strike's payoff: a direct crow impact detonates bird and target both, sparing bystanders.

item.name: Circling
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the second Circling swing tears the target's upper body free.

item.name: Bird Control
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the crow crushes the target until both burst into blood and feathers.

item.name: Real Knife
item.cardSummary: Passive: every landed hit floats an exact damage number over the target, Undertale style.

item.name: Real Knife
item.damage: 10 pre M1 set, 4 for front dash
item.cardSummary: Tradeoff passive: slower, weaker M1s (2-2-2-4) than any other character.

item.name: Soul Flip
item.cardSummary: Extended dashes both ways, but back dashing puts the front dash on cooldown.

item.name: Check
item.cardSummary: The Act then Check menu reveals a nearby opponent's stats before the fight escalates.

item.name: Onslaught
item.cardSummary: A wound-up slash into stabs and kicks ending in a ragdolling kick; only the opening slash pierces block.

item.name: Lethal Wound
item.cardSummary: A running slide that pins a struck enemy for three stabs and a kick.

item.name: Bloody Mary
item.cardSummary: A backward spin-kick into a forward slash that chains into a beatdown on anyone caught.

item.name: Fight
item.damage: 2 for first hit, 2 for QTE fail, 10 for success.
item.cardSummary: A knife thrust into a quick-time attack bar: the white line's timing decides the payoff.

item.name: SINCE WHEN WERE YOU THE ONE IN CONTROL?
item.cardSummary: The Awakening: knocked back, the soul reassembles on DETERMINATION and the user handstands back up.

item.name: Check
item.cardSummary: The awakened Check, unchanged from base.

item.name: Cursed Remedy
item.cardSummary: Three zig-zag sidesteps into a lunging stab, slashes, and a roundhouse finish.

item.name: Reset
item.cardSummary: A counter stance with a red outline: strike it and you are dragged to an abyss to face Chara.

item.name: Atonement
item.cardSummary: A knife juggle caught with a kick, then a lunge, upward swing, and finishing stab.

item.name: Seven Souls
item.damage: 2.5 per rush hit, 5 for swing, 20 for cutscene
item.cardSummary: A kneeling charge where Chara's soul joins the rush, overwhelming whoever the swing lands on.

item.name: Lethal Wound
item.cardSummary: Finisher: a stabbing flurry ending with a slit throat and a taunt.

item.name: Cursed Remedy
item.cardSummary: Awakened Cursed Remedy: the slash barrage runs faster, and the final blow changes into a launcher variation.

item.name: Swordsmanship
item.cardSummary: Kit passive: a holstered katana that unsheathes for M1s and katana skills, paired with a cursed ring necklace.

item.name: Rika
item.cardSummary: The special partially manifests Rika, the Queen of Curses, as an intangible companion at your right whose moves interweave with yours.

item.name: Severing Path
item.cardSummary: An 18-stud sliding floor sweep with a charged blade; landing it locks the enemy in place for a follow-up.

item.name: Resolute Slash
item.cardSummary: Aim within 25 studs to vanish mid-windup and reappear at the mark to finish a long swing.

item.name: Outburst
item.damage: 2 for swing, 4 for burst (+2 per stage, up to +6)
item.cardSummary: A cursed-energy swing that erupts into a giant uncounterable burst dealing damage through block.

item.name: Outburst
item.damage: None on melee, depends on projectile for bullet
item.cooldown: 4s for melee parry, none for bullet
item.cardSummary: Outburst's hidden parry: taking a hit within a quarter second turns the swing into a parry that stuns melee attackers.

item.name: Second Wind
item.cooldown: 16s, none if failed on the first use
item.cardSummary: A 20-stud rush with melee i-frames that grabs the first enemy by the face for a fierce slam.

item.name: Rika Smash
item.cardSummary: Rika's fist swells and slams down on the target, bouncing them upward.

item.name: Rika Launch
item.cardSummary: Rika boosts you forward from behind, feinting whatever move you were performing.

item.name: Rika Haymaker
item.cardSummary: Rika drifts to an enemy within 10 studs and winds up a heavy knockback punch; blocked, it stuns without ragdolling.

item.name: True Love
item.cardSummary: The Awakening vow: tearing the necklace and wearing its ring fully manifests Rika for the awakened kit.

item.name: Copy Wheel
item.cardSummary: The copy technique: an Awakening-button wheel lists cursed techniques stolen from opponents, unlocked through specific requirements.

item.name: Rika
item.cardSummary: Fully manifested Rika keeps her base behavior but stays out until the Awakening ends, carrying four new moves.

item.name: Elbow Rush
item.damage: 4 for elbow hit, 5 for flurry (8 with Rika), 6 for last hit
item.cardSummary: A 38.5-stud elbow dash that sends the target spinning, with the user flickering behind them afterward.

item.name: Copy
item.damage: Depends on the move usedNone (Cursed Speech)
item.cooldown: 15s for Cursed Speech and base copies25s for Awakening copies
item.cardSummary: The default copied technique, Cursed Speech: mouth-marked commands that affect every player within range.

item.name: Energy Ripple
item.cardSummary: Drives the blade into the floor to pulse a 27-stud repulsion field.

item.name: Authentic Mutual Love
item.cardSummary: The Domain Expansion: a stone platform under a sky of knots, with blades answering every move inside.

item.name: Rika Downslam
item.cardSummary: Rika pins the target under one arm and slams them into the floor.

item.name: Rika Slam
item.damage: 12, 1 for grab, 2 per slam, 3 for last slam
item.cardSummary: Rika grabs a target by the leg and slams them five times; an alert target can evade out early.

item.name: True Love Beam
item.cardSummary: Rika grows giant behind a pink orb and fires the pair's combined energy as a beam.

item.name: Rika Throw
item.damage: 8 to 18 to target0.5 to 22 to user (miss)
item.cardSummary: Rika throws you like a projectile; crashing into an enemy ragdolls them with distance-scaled damage.

item.name: Shrine
item.damage: 8 for katana, 20 for slashes (5 per slash)
item.cardSummary: A katana hit triggers Shrine's second blade, Cleave: four slashes with stun and knockback.

item.name: Thin Ice Breaker
item.damage: 8 for katana, 20 for Thin Ice Breaker
item.cardSummary: A Sky Manipulation empowered blow that cracks the sky and disables the target's ragdoll cancel.

item.name: Clairvoyance
item.cardSummary: A copied Clairvoyance: a blood-drawn manga panel marks the enemy for 10 seconds and turns their attacks readable.

item.name: Cursed Speech
item.cardSummary: A copied Cursed Speech strike: the command Ochire (Plummet) grounds the target flat.

item.name: Shikigami
item.cardSummary: Sends three winged Rika-head shikigami to swarm the struck opponent for three seconds.

item.name: Severing Path
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the final Severing Path slash takes the head.

item.name: Resolute Slash
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the slash passes through the skull without resistance.

item.name: Outburst
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the swing halves the target while the burst finishes the rest.

item.name: Rika Smash
item.cardSummary: Finisher: Rika's fist leaves only a puddle.

item.name: Rika Downslam
item.cardSummary: Finisher: Rika keeps pressing until the target bursts.

item.name: True Love Beam
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the beam atomizes the target into black mist.

item.name: Rika Throw
item.cardSummary: At 60+ studs, the thrown user lands with a sparking black flash.

item.name: Authentic Mutual Love: Shrine
item.cardSummary: Domain finisher via Shrine: every limb and the head come off.

item.name: Authentic Mutual Love: Cursed Speech
item.cardSummary: Domain finisher via Cursed Speech: the command Shine (Die) detonates the target.

item.name: Judge Gavel
item.cardSummary: Kit passive: the gavel splits the second M1 into two hits, and Extended Swings resets the M1 count to it.

item.name: No Escape
item.cardSummary: A gavel throw that flies 50 studs and boomerangs back, recallable early.

item.name: Extended Swings
item.cardSummary: The gavel extends into a hammer for three swings and a grounding slam.

item.name: Justice Served
item.cardSummary: The gavel inflates to comedic size for a crushing slam that bounces the target skyward.

item.name: Judgement's Reach
item.cardSummary: A handle-extension poke that knocks back with light stun and cannot be fully blocked.

item.name: Pressing Charges
item.damage: 4 for kick, 3.5 for swing (+11 for 14.5 HP targets)
item.cardSummary: A block-ignoring kick into a timed rush that meets the target exactly as their stun ends.

item.name: Deadly Sentencing
item.cardSummary: The Awakening domain: a courtroom platform ringed by suspended guillotines.

item.name: Death Penalty
item.cardSummary: When the domain breaks, the gavel shatters into the Executioner's Sword and the death-by-sword rule is declared.

item.name: Executioner's Sword
item.cardSummary: Sword passive: 12-stud M1 reach and six-hit strings, trading raw damage for range.

item.name: Domain Amplification
item.cardSummary: The special veils you in a thin layer of domain that eats one attack's damage and stun.

item.name: Execution
item.damage: 25, 10 for lunge, 15 for toss 300 on execution
item.cardSummary: A charged sword dash that impales a limb and forces the target to sever it to escape the technique.

item.name: Final Judgement
item.cardSummary: A running spin-swipe that starts a duel quick-time event on hit.

item.name: Final Judgement
item.cardSummary: Failing Final Judgement's QTE lets the target vault the stab and eat only a kick.

item.name: Verdict
item.damage: 5 for first hit, 5 for second (300 on kill, and none on block)
item.cardSummary: A hilt-first knock-away into a dashing flip slash.

item.name: Triple Sentence
item.cardSummary: Launches the sword to sever a limb and stack Execution, throwable up to three times.

item.name: Extended Swings
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the last swing is an overhead skull-crusher.

item.name: Justice Served
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the giant hammer leaves nothing solid behind.

item.name: Justice Served
item.cardSummary: Easter egg: used on a headless body, a disgruntled Hiromi panel flashes with a vine boom.

item.name: Judgement's Reach
item.cardSummary: Finisher: a decisive overhead gavel hit ends the target skull-first.

item.name: Pressing Charges
item.cardSummary: Extended finisher: the target is swung around, slammed upward, then dropped.

item.name: Execution
item.damage: 10 for first hit, 300 for the second
item.cardSummary: At low HP or 2 Execution stacks the lunge fells the target for a blade-and-stomp finish.

item.name: Triple Sentence
item.cardSummary: Depleting the final Execution stack triggers a flash-step torso stab that slashes the target away.

item.name: Arm Wrap
item.cardSummary: Form passive: a 1.25x-height frame with the left arm wrapped, restricting all melee to the right hand.

item.name: Flower Field
item.cardSummary: Front dashes instead scatter a 25-stud flower field that lingers two seconds and feeds the kit's setups.

item.name: Plant Guidance
item.cardSummary: Aim within 65 studs to mark a glowing zone for a delayed plant attack, castable mid-move.

item.name: Root Swarm
item.cardSummary: An arm plunged into the earth grows a 50-stud straight line of roots over two seconds.

item.name: Surging Thorns
item.cardSummary: Two thorned wooden balls shove targets in a 35-stud range back into three rising thorn spikes.

item.name: Bud Shot
item.cardSummary: Chucks two cursed buds 70 studs that latch on and refund 7 seconds of Plant Guidance cooldown.

item.name: Defense Response
item.cardSummary: A reclined surge into a violent arm smack with short stun knockback.

item.name: Unwrap
item.cardSummary: The Awakening: the wrap comes off, revealing a flower-budded arm and the unrestricted kit.

item.name: Unwrap
item.cardSummary: Unwrapped, both hands join the fight with a full M1 string again.

item.name: Energy Absorb
item.cardSummary: Draws cursed energy from nearby foliage into a golden-aura boosted state.

item.name: Root Rampage
item.cardSummary: Kneels to steer a tangible root line for seven full seconds, guided in any direction.

item.name: Flower Field
item.damage: 4 on interruption7 for spike launch, 7 for bounce
item.cardSummary: The awakened field: an aimed flower carpet that erupts a giant launching spike.

item.name: Cursed Buds
item.cardSummary: A massive turret flower fires 15 cursed buds at the nearest enemy.

item.name: Shining Sea of Growing Branches
item.cardSummary: The domain: a lakeside grove that saps foliage energy to supercharge its caster.

item.name: Surging Thorns
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the middle thorn stakes the target through the chest; uppercuts share it.

item.name: Projectionism
item.cardSummary: Form passive: 2-damage M1s and altered movement rules that define the projection playstyle.

item.name: Projection Sorcery
item.cardSummary: Aim within 50 studs to cross the distance in one second, leaving an afterimage behind.

item.name: Projection Breaker
item.cardSummary: A 15-stud backdash with melee i-frames spinning back into a heavy throwing kick.

item.name: Bleedout
item.damage: 5 for stab, 3 per Bleed stack,1.3 per tick for Hemorrhage
item.cardSummary: A tanto spin-stab to the abdomen that layers on status effects rather than extending combos.

item.name: Decisive Strike
item.damage: 6 for first hit, 8 for barrage (0.5 per hit)
item.cardSummary: A 35-stud technique-boosted run into a punch that unloads a flurry on contact.

item.name: Cursory Impact
item.cardSummary: A speed-boosted quick step reappearing with an immediate backhand smack.

item.name: Vengeance
item.cardSummary: The Awakening opens with a slowed Bleedout that counters any melee interruption.

item.name: Vengeance
item.cardSummary: The reincarnated form: faster movement and hovering, courtesy of a vengeful curse's physiology.

item.name: Acceleration
item.cardSummary: A rapid spin that damages everything nearby while stacking up movement speed.

item.name: Top Speed
item.cardSummary: Air intakes fire the user forward to crash their shell into whatever stands in the way.

item.name: Flash Freezing
item.cardSummary: Freezes the air into a line of 15 glass frames; each shattered frame damages whoever broke it.

item.name: Tendril Grab
item.cardSummary: Underground tendrils erupt to grab and hold enemies within 25 studs for about a second.

item.name: Time Cell Moon Palace
item.cardSummary: The handsign expands Time Cell Moon Palace, dropping the curse form back to the base moveset inside the domain.

item.name: Projection Breaker
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the post-dash kick lands with everything behind it, sending the target barreling.

item.name: Bleedout
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the abdomen stab blitzes into a neck stab, tossing the body aside.

item.name: Decisive Strike
item.damage: 8.5 for extra barrage, 20 for last hit.
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the barrage accelerates until one arm suffices, the other idly fixing their hair.

item.name: Flash Freezing
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the target shatters along with the glass frames.

item.name: Infinity
item.cardSummary: Infinity passive: blocking is just a pose, since attacks stop themselves short of the user.

item.name: Limitless
item.cardSummary: The special warps you through manipulated space to appear in front of your cursor's target.

item.name: Lapse Blue
item.cardSummary: Negative energy forms a vacuum at up to 35 studs that drags the opponent in.

item.name: Reversal Red
item.cardSummary: Positive energy fires a red orb 40 studs that detonates in a repelling blast.

item.name: Rapid Punches
item.cardSummary: A spin kick that locks a nearby enemy for a punch barrage and a ragdolling final blow.

item.name: Twofold Kick
item.cardSummary: An upward kick with on-hit i-frames that anchors the enemy mid-air for an unblockable second kick.

item.name: Six Eyes
item.cardSummary: The Awakening: the blindfold comes off, the Six Eyes open, and the awakened kit begins.

item.name: Limitless
item.cardSummary: The awakened warp, unchanged from base.

item.name: Lapse Blue MAX
item.damage: 44, 2.2 per tick+20.9 on kill, 1.1 per tick
item.cardSummary: A steerable blue vortex that pulls and grinds everything near it for 20 ticks.

item.name: Reversal Red MAX
item.cardSummary: A charged repelling orb that pierces straight through enemies before fading.

item.name: Hollow Purple
item.cardSummary: The combined technique: an imaginary purple mass that atomizes everything along its path.

item.name: Infinite Void
item.cardSummary: The crossed-finger handsign expands Infinite Void, a galaxy-scape domain that overloads all who stand inside.

item.name: Lapse Blue
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the pulled enemy is kicked skyward and buried under rubble ripped from the map.

item.name: Reversal Red
item.cardSummary: Finisher: a small red ball that bursts targets apart on contact, shared across its variants.

item.name: Rapid Punches
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the barrage ends in a Black Flash that sends the body flying.

item.name: Twofold Kick
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the airborne enemy takes a point-blank Reversal Red.

item.name: 0.2 Domain

item.name: Lapse Blue MAX
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the vortex tears targets apart and swallows the pieces, lingering afterward.

item.name: Reversal Red MAX
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the orb splits whoever it finishes, scattering the parts.

item.name: Hollow Purple
item.cardSummary: Finisher: Hollow Purple erases everything except, famously, the legs.

item.name: Naturally Selected
item.cardSummary: The locust curse's form: head antennas, wings, and an insect frame born of humanity's hatred for the swarm.

item.name: Fluttering Pounce
item.cardSummary: Spread wings carry the user 25 studs in their facing direction; an M1 cancels the flight early.

item.name: Clever
item.cardSummary: A crouched charge into a ragdolling punch barrage that leaves the target stunned in place.

item.name: Black Mucus
item.cardSummary: Spits a dark mucus ball up to 60 studs that ragdolls and stacks a 15 percent slow.

item.name: Crushing Jaws
item.cardSummary: Three biting head swings; the third grabs and drags the target with i-frames along the way.

item.name: Wing Throw
item.cardSummary: A reaching grab into brief free flight before the target is hurled away.

item.name: Directed Poison
item.cardSummary: The insect abdomen's sharp end stings the target as the user declares victory in Japanese.

item.name: Crushing Jaws
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the third bite takes the head clean off, jaw-held for a moment.

item.name: Shoot!
item.cardSummary: Kit passive: an inexperienced fighter leaning on a katana-blade cursed tool fused to a humanoid hand.

item.name: Helping Hand
item.cardSummary: Aim at a target within 150 studs and the Hand Sword detaches to stalk them on its own.

item.name: Ambush
item.cardSummary: A forward slash that ragdolls, lunging 15 to 20 studs if used airborne.

item.name: Backstab
item.cardSummary: A quick stab that stuns briefly, or much longer when landed from behind.

item.name: Trip
item.cardSummary: A tripping kick that plants the target face-first, with its own quirky interaction rules.

item.name: Cheap Shot
item.cardSummary: Throws the blade 60 studs, piercing enemies but unarming the user until it is retrieved.

item.name: Jawbreaker
item.cardSummary: An unarmed-only Awakening usable even in stun: the Hand Sword slides back and hurls itself at the target.

item.name: Ambush
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the slash takes the neck cleanly.

item.name: Backstab
item.damage: 18, 12 for stabs (4 per stab), 3 for pin, 3 for kick
item.cardSummary: Finisher: three gleeful chest thrusts pin the backstabbed target down.

item.name: Cheap Shot
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the spinning thrown blade severs the target's right arm.

item.name: Eight-Handled Divergent Sila Divine General
item.cardSummary: The Ten Shadows' final shikigami: a giant whose size changes even how it bounces off walls.

item.name: Adaptation Wheel
item.cardSummary: The adaptation wheel above the Ritual Bar cycles Mahoraga's modes with each Awakening press.

item.name: Special Mode: Sword of Extermination
item.cardSummary: Special Mode: the third and fourth M1s of the Sword of Extermination ignore block entirely.

item.name: Divine Pummel

item.cardSummary: A grabbing arm swing that slams caught opponents twice before punching them away.

item.name: Ground Pitch

item.name: Earthquake
item.cardSummary: A fist slammed into the floor that smashes everything in front.

item.name: Ground Pitch
item.cardSummary: Finisher: the picked-up enemy shatters on impact after the throw.

item.name: Restoration
item.cardSummary: On death, phoenix flames rebuild the user, who stands back up stronger for it.

item.name: Blazing Soar
item.cardSummary: Fire wings launch the user upward, dragging enemies along into an air combo.

item.name: Phoenix Maelstrom
item.cardSummary: Two fiery claw slashes into an uptilting kick that carries both fighters skyward.

item.name: Aetherflare Talon
item.cardSummary: A hopping dropkick that sets the landing zone alight, hop omitted in the air.

item.name: Scorchrise
item.cardSummary: A flame pillar decombusts the user into an invulnerable flying energy orb.

item.name: Hexflare Charm
item.cardSummary: Conjured flame bullets barrel forward, aimable in any direction even grounded.

item.name: Immortal Blaze
item.cardSummary: The Awakening chains both of the character's awakening sequences back to back.

item.name: Danmaku
item.cardSummary: Awakened M1s become a barrage of pink bullets that delete opponents on contact.

item.name: Flight
item.cardSummary: The awakened special toggles unrestricted free flight with no cost or endlag.

item.name: Child Of The Clouds

item.name: Instant Transmission
